proposal.hypothesis: Exploratory controlled-deletion hypothesis: removing Your from c1ee6a7cd5cec preserves completed play without supplied-engine searches at two file words. The analogous deletion in the reasoning family yielded cd6bc3ff4740d's measured 3/3, motivating but not validating transfer to knowledge. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction, and missing, partial or errored games never count as success. The parent's custom evaluator remains a separate confound.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds. Record alternate computation and legal enumeration separately; equal outcomes do not establish equivalence or robustness.
proposal.ablation: Delete only the leading Your and capitalize Own in c1ee6a7cd5cec's asset. Secondary matched historical contrast: replace reasoning with knowledge in cd6bc3ff4740d, retaining Own and the period at equal word/byte cost. Two file words, 14 UTF-8 bytes, no title or trailing newline, at /workdir/definition.md. Zero rendered prompt additions/deletions/replacements and zero prompt word-edit distance; 17 link/markup bytes; two target lexical words; four total non-original lexical words; zero net prompt words and two net prompt-plus-file words. Count file deletion/capitalization or substitution edits even when net cost matches. Hold the exact linked opening, file presence/location, all remaining game text and actor settings fixed; replace only the original introductory sentence. Historical comparisons are temporally unmatched. The paired child deletes a different word from the same parent, not a pure own insertion contrast.
